# zenn-content

> A bilingual (Japanese / English) content repository of 48+ technical articles on AI agent architecture, Claude Code workflows, and LLM engineering. Articles are cross-posted to Zenn (JP) and Dev.to (EN). Writing, reviewing, translating, and publishing are all orchestrated by Claude Code agents.

## Core documentation

- [Full AI Reference](llms-full.txt): self-contained Q&A, glossary, and project facts for AI search engines and AI agents
- [README (English)](README.md): human-facing narrative index of published articles
- [README (Japanese)](README.ja.md): 日本語 narrative index
- [Contributor guide](CLAUDE.md): writing guidelines, frontmatter conventions, review workflow
- [Architecture](docs/CODEMAPS/architecture.md): directory layout and publishing data flow

## Substack essays (mirror)

Human essays first published on Substack, mirrored here as Markdown to extend the LLM-readable corpus. Out of Zenn convention scope — not cross-posted to Zenn or Dev.to.

- [Where Does the Accountability Externalized by AI Go?](substack/ai-externalized-accountability-pollution-en.md) (EN) / [AIによって外部化された責任は、どこへ行くのか](substack/ai-externalized-accountability-pollution.md) (JP)

## Publishing pipeline

- [schedule.json](scripts/schedule.json): Dev.to publication schedule, source of truth
- [publish.py](scripts/publish.py): Dev.to cross-post API client (manual, ad-hoc / `--update`)
- [devto_crosspost.py](scripts/devto_crosspost.py): schedule-driven Dev.to cross-poster (manual run; auto cron retired 2026-05)
- [plan_schedule.py](scripts/plan_schedule.py): schedule.json generator
- [generate_cover.py](scripts/generate_cover.py): cover image generator (Pillow, 1000x420)

Zenn (JP) publishing is not scripted — it uses Zenn's native `published_at` frontmatter scheduling.

## Claude Code integration

- [.claude/rules/content-integrity.md](.claude/rules/content-integrity.md): Content Integrity principle (content decided by author, distribution optimized without changing content)
- [.claude/rules/zenn-writing.md](.claude/rules/zenn-writing.md): Zenn platform overlay (title length, frontmatter, :::message conventions)
- [.claude/agents/zenn-drafter.md](.claude/agents/zenn-drafter.md): article writer agent (analyze → write → self-review)
- [.claude/agents/devto-translator.md](.claude/agents/devto-translator.md): JP→EN translator + Dev.to publisher
- [.claude/refs/translation-rules.md](.claude/refs/translation-rules.md): JP→EN translation standards
- [.claude/refs/schedule-schema.md](.claude/refs/schedule-schema.md): schedule.json schema
